blocks.prompt: 3 Find the equation of the ellipse as the locus of points \(P(x, y)\) such that the sum of the distances from \(P\) to the points \((-3, 0)\) and \((3, 0)\) is 10.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh locus (raaste) ka sawal hai: point P ek shart ke mutabiq chalta hai, aur humein woh equation chahiye jo us ke har maqam (position) ko poora kare.
Shart hai ke \(P\) ke do fixed points \((-3, 0)\) aur \((3, 0)\) se faaslon ka jama 10 hai. Yeh bilkul ellipse ki definition hai, jis ke foci yahi do points hain.
Plan: distance formula se shart likhein, phir 6.4 ki derivation ki tarah do dafa 'akela karo aur square karo'.
Aakhir mein definition wale chhote raaste se jawab ki tasdeeq karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(|PF'| + |PF| = 10\), jahan \(F'(-3, 0)\), \(F(3, 0)\).
Maloom karna: woh equation jo \(P(x, y)\) poori karta hai.
Tareeqa: distance formula, phir do square roots ko akela kar ke do dafa square karna.

Ek root akela karein
\[\sqrt{(x+3)^2 + y^2}\]
\[= 10 - \sqrt{(x-3)^2 + y^2}\]
Kyun: agar dono roots ek taraf hon aur square karein to \(2\sqrt{AB}\) wala naya mushkil term aa jata hai. Har taraf ek root ho to left wala root square se poora khatam ho jata hai.

Dono sides ka square
\[(x+3)^2 + y^2 = 100\]
\[\quad - 20\sqrt{(x-3)^2 + y^2} + (x-3)^2 + y^2\]
Kyun: right side par \((p - q)^2 = p^2 - 2pq + q^2\), jahan \(p = 10\) aur \(q\) root hai; \(2 \times 10 = 20\).

Khol kar simplify karein
\[x^2 + 6x + 9 + y^2 = 100\]
\[\quad - 20\sqrt{(x-3)^2 + y^2}\]
\[\quad + x^2 - 6x + 9 + y^2\]
\[12x = 100 - 20\sqrt{(x-3)^2 + y^2}\]
\[20\sqrt{(x-3)^2 + y^2} = 100 - 12x\]
\[5\sqrt{(x-3)^2 + y^2} = 25 - 3x\]
Kyun: \(x^2\), \(y^2\) aur 9 dono taraf hain, cancel ho gaye. \(6x - (-6x) = 12x\). Phir 4 se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(-6x\) ko doosri taraf le jane par \(+6x\) banta hai, is liye \(12x\) aata hai, zero nahi.

Doosri dafa square
\[25[(x-3)^2 + y^2] = (25 - 3x)^2\]
\[25x^2 - 150x + 225 + 25y^2\]
\[= 625 - 150x + 9x^2\]
\[16x^2 + 25y^2 = 400\]
Kyun: aakhri root bhi khatam karna hai. Left par \(25 \times\) bracket, right par \((25 - 3x)^2 = 625 - 150x + 9x^2\). \(-150x\) dono taraf cancel hua, phir \(25x^2 - 9x^2 = 16x^2\) aur \(625 - 225 = 400\).

400 se divide karein
\[\frac{x^2}{25} + \frac{y^2}{16} = 1\]
Kyun: standard form mein right side 1 hoti hai.

Ek nazar mein
Locus ke sawal mein shart ko lafzon se math mein badalna pehla qadam hai. Yahan shart khud ellipse ki definition thi, is liye jawab bhi ellipse aaya.

Tasdeeq
Definition wala chhota raasta: \(2a = 10\), \(a = 5\), \(c = 3\), \(b^2 = 25 - 9 = 16\): wohi ellipse. Vertex \((5, 0)\) ke foci se faasle 8 aur 2 hain, jama 10.
Kyun: do mukhtalif raaston se ek hi jawab aaya. Exam mein locus maanga ho to lamba raasta likhiye; chhota raasta sirf tasdeeq ke liye.
